title: Cost Advisor playbooks: batching & KV-cache cards + safe apply/rollback activity stream
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Build a first-class Console experience for automated cost-optimization recommendations focused on batching and KV cache suggestions. Users should be able to: view succinct advisor cards that explain the recommendation and estimated unit savings, preview an exact config diff that would be applied, run the change in a sandbox (safe apply), and see a tamper-proof activity stream with rollback links and rationale. The UX should make trade-offs clear (latency vs cost, memory impact) and integrate with existing rollouts and canaries APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor cards surface: recommendation title, short rationale, estimated monthly cost delta, confidence band, affected routes/models, and a primary CTA: Preview Diff

Preview Diff shows: exact JSON patch (read-only), human-friendly summary of changed fields, potential regressions note, and a simulated cost delta computed from historical traffic for the selected window
Safe Apply workflow: user can run changes in a sandbox environment or schedule a canary rollout; the UI creates a single atomic change request and returns an activity id

Apply & Rollback history: every apply creates an immutable audit entry with who/when/why, diff snapshot, runtime telemetry (cost delta observed, p95 latency), and a one-click rollback that enqueues the reverse change with optional reason
Integrations: links to PRs, design spec, and Technical Review in the activity entry; ability to attach a link to a runbook when applying
Telemetry: events emitted for preview_open, apply_requested, apply_completed, rollback_requested, rollback_completed with change_id and confidence metadata
Access control: only users with Apply permission see the apply button; read-only users can preview diffs and comment
Unit tests and E2E coverage for diff preview rendering, apply path, and activity listing UI
Documentation updated: Console Optimize docs, API reference for apply endpoints, and migration notes for teams using manual configs
ux_notes: Card compact mode collapses details to one line but expands on hover/click to show cost estimate and affected routes.

Use a color bar to indicate risk: green for low-risk suggestions (pure caching TTL increases), amber for batching that may affect tail latency, red for changing model variants or aggressive cache eviction policies.
Diff preview supports side-by-side JSON patch and a plain-language summary. Provide a toggle to view simulated impact for last 7/30/90 days.
Activity stream grouped by deployment target and change author; support filters for status (applied/failed/rolled back) and tags (canary, sandbox, automated)
Add a lightweight comments thread on each activity entry for cross-team sign-off and incident notes
api_contract: POST /v1/optimize/preview - body: { change_plan_id, window_days } returns cost_estimate, diff_patch, confidence_score
POST /v1/optimize/apply - body: { change_plan_id, target, mode: [sandbox|canary|full], note } returns activity_id and status
GET /v1/optimize/activity/{activity_id} - returns immutable snapshot: applied_by, timestamp, diff_patch, telemetry_summary, attachments
POST /v1/optimize/activity/{activity_id}/rollback - body: { reason } returns rollback_activity_id and scheduled_time
rollout_plan: Week 1: internal alpha with product + 1 reliability team; wire up preview endpoints and basic cards
Week 2: add sandbox apply and activity stream entries; run synthetic experiments with staging traffic
Week 3: enable canary apply for a small subset of customers; monitor cost delta vs latency metrics, validate rollback path
Week 4: beta release to broader customers behind feature flag; collect feedback and iterate on card language and risk signals
GA gating: support matrix for RBAC, telemetry coverage >= 95% of events, reconciliation job to validate estimated vs observed savings
telemetry_and_metrics: primary KPI: realized monthly cost delta for applied recommendations (observed vs estimated)
secondary KPI: number of successful automated rollbacks within 24 hours
reliability signals: p50/p95 latency delta per route, error rate change, GPU memory utilization delta
adoption metrics: previews per week, applies per week, % of advisors acted upon
security/audit: immutable activity count, average time to attach runbook
open_decisions: How to compute confidence_score: use bootstrapped historical traffic vs model-based simulation? Action: ENG to prototype both, due 2025-02-21 (ENG-4128).
Retention for activity entries: 12 months by default with an enterprise configurable retention policy? Security asked for 7 years — need legal check.

Rollback semantics: should rollback be an automatic inverse patch or a new patch that restores previous values? Preference is inverse patch to preserve intent, but ENG will confirm potential edge cases (ENG-4210).
Sandbox environment isolation: map to existing dedicated staging clusters or provision ephemeral sandbox per apply? Cost trade-off analysis required.
